system.description:
While you are touching a Prop with the [Natural] tag, your [Recovery] is increased by +6. Your "Solitary Cedar Style" is treated as having +1 SR (it may exceed its max SR). (Self: Nature) You gain [Cancel]. The rating of this [Cancel] is [(SR of your active [Servant Summon] skill) ×3]. A piece of armor made by weaving parasitic vine and hardening the bark of a large tree. By deeply connecting with nature, it grants the user the power of its vitality and wildness.

Blessed Parasitic Tree[Core Material](240G)+Chain Tunic(490G)×2+[Magic Catalyst 11](120G)×2+Crafting Cost(650G)
